subject.title: [Feature]: Enrich before_tool_call event with action classification and input provenance

question: What public policy-facts contract should OpenClaw expose to before_tool_call: action categories, composable capability flags, input/requester provenance, external-content provenance, or a versioned combination of those, and which plugin trust tiers may see each field?
rationale: This is public Plugin SDK security-policy surface; automation cannot choose the taxonomy, redaction boundary, or ordinary-versus-trusted plugin visibility without maintainer/security intent.

options.title: Define one unified policy-facts contract
options.body: Approve one additive contract that covers action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

options.title: Land narrow provenance slices first
options.body: Accept narrower PRs such as externalContent or requester-origin signals while keeping this issue open for the broader action/provenance design.

options.title: Defer hook enrichment
options.body: Keep the existing hook shape and require security plugins to use tool names or trusted policy internals until the broader Security Matrix/capability model is settled.

recommendation.title: Define one unified policy-facts contract
recommendation.body: Approve one additive contract that covers action or capability facts plus safe provenance fields, then implement it with docs, API baseline updates, and cross-path tests.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the clearest current-main hook contract history and is already connected to adjacent security-policy direction.
